source_row.rationale: Current recommended first aid for a venomous snake bite includes keeping the client calm (to help slow venom spread), immobilizing the affected limb at or slightly below heart level, removing constrictive items like jewelry or tight clothing near the bite site (in anticipation of swelling), and seeking emergency medical care promptly for possible antivenom treatment — outdated practices such as tourniquets, ice application, incision/suction, or attempting to suck out venom are no longer recommended and can worsen outcomes.
